account_settings_desc: Update your name, email address, and mobile number.
save_failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
security_settings_desc: Change your login password. You will need your current password to do this.
password_min: Password must be at least 6 characters.
brand_settings_desc: Change the application name shown across all portals — sidebar, login page, and browser tab.
two_factor_desc: Add an extra layer of security to your account. After logging in with your password, you'll also need to enter a code from your authenticator app.
two_factor_scan_instructions: Scan the QR code below with Google Authenticator, Authy, or any TOTP app. Then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
two_factor_enter_code: Enter the 6-digit code from your app to confirm
two_factor_enabled_desc: Two-factor authentication is active on your account. Every login requires your authenticator app code.
two_factor_disable_confirm: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app to disable two-factor authentication.
